caption:
म्यूजिक डायरेक्टर हिमेश रेशमिया अब डायरेक्शन की दुनिया में धमाका करने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार हैं! 🔥

हाल ही में कोमल नाहटा के साथ इंटरव्यू में हिमेश रेशमिया ने अपने फ्यूचर प्लान्स शेयर किए। हिमेश ने बताया कि उनके पास डायरेक्शन के लिए 2-3 ब्लॉकबस्टर स्क्रिप्ट्स एकदम तैयार हैं।

हिमेश का दावा है कि उनकी डायरेक्ट की हुई फिल्म का म्यूजिक रिलीज के पहले दिन ही 100 करोड़ रुपये जुटा लेगा! 💰

अपनी एक्टिंग की इच्छा पर बात करते हुए हिमेश ने कहा कि वो सुपरस्टार एक्टर बनना चाहते हैं और बनकर रहेंगे। उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि अमिताभ बच्चन की 13वीं फिल्म हिट हुई थी और वो खुद भी 12 फिल्में कर चुके हैं, इसलिए उनकी 13वीं फिल्म ब्लॉकबस्टर होगी। 😎

क्या आपको लगता है कि हिमेश रेशमिया की 13वीं फिल्म अमिताभ बच्चन की तरह सुपर-हिट साबित होगी? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में बताएं! 🎬

Himesh Reshammiya recently had a conversation with Komal Nahta, during which he opened up about his plans to turn director. He also made it clear that he intends to continue acting regularly and is determined to become a superstar actor. Interestingly, he revealed that he already has scripts ready for his directorial debut.
Himesh Reshammiya was asked, “Can we see a film that mentions ‘Directed by Himesh Reshammiya’ in the future?” Himesh replied, “100% you’ll see that. When I used to produce serials, I used to be asked, ‘Will you ever turn music director?’ Today, when I have achieved so much in the field of music and films, I do want to try my hand at direction. However, my vision is very definite for my directorial venture in terms of scale, emotional connect and beautiful songs. I am very clear about these aspects.”
When asked if his directorial debut would be a musical romance, Himesh Reshammiya answered, “I have 2-3 ideas. The scripts are ready and they are blockbusters. The music in my directorial venture would be such that it would fetch Rs. 100 crore on the day of release! I am very sure of that.”
He was also asked if he had any unfulfilled wishes. Himesh Reshammiya confessed, “I want to become a superstar actor. Mujhe banna hi hai aur banoonga bhi. Yeh toh hona hi hai, aaj nahin toh kal . Amitabh Bachchan’s 13th film was a hit. I have done 12 films until now. So, my thirteenth film would be a blockbuster!”
